general.title: General settings
general.description: Change where Intentional reads rule files from.

rules.title: Rule files
rules.description: Manage Intentional rule files in {rule_dir}. Files: {file_count}. {filenames}

fire.name: Fire intent
fire.description: Manually fire a user intent for a target entity.

target.name: Target
target.description: The entity_id to apply the intent to (e.g. light.living_room).

state.name: State
state.description: Optional target state such as on, off, toggle, open, closed, or stop.

brightness.name: Brightness
brightness.description: Optional brightness on Home Assistant's 0-255 scale.

color_temp_k.name: Color temperature (K)
color_temp_k.description: Optional light color temperature in Kelvin.

color_temp_mired.name: Color temperature (mired)
color_temp_mired.description: Optional light color temperature in mireds.

rgb_color.name: RGB color
rgb_color.description: Optional light RGB color as [red, green, blue].

rgbw_color.name: RGBW color
rgbw_color.description: Optional light RGBW color as [red, green, blue, white].

rgbww_color.name: RGBWW color
rgbww_color.description: Optional light RGBWW color as [red, green, blue, cold white, warm white].

hs_color.name: HS color
hs_color.description: Optional light hue/saturation color as [hue, saturation].

xy_color.name: XY color
xy_color.description: Optional light XY color as [x, y].

flash.name: Flash
flash.description: Optional light flash mode such as short or long.

volume_level.name: Volume level
volume_level.description: Optional media player or siren volume from 0.0 to 1.0.

tone.name: Siren tone
tone.description: Optional siren tone name or ID for siren.turn_on targets.

media_action.name: Media action
media_action.description: Optional media player action such as pause, next, play_media, mute, seek, or join.

media_content_id.name: Media content ID
media_content_id.description: Optional media content ID for media_player.play_media.

media_content_type.name: Media content type
media_content_type.description: Optional media content type for media_player.play_media.

seek_position.name: Seek position
seek_position.description: Optional media player seek position in seconds.

group_members.name: Group members
group_members.description: Optional media player entity IDs to join to this player.

position.name: Position
position.description: Optional cover or valve position from 0 to 100.

tilt_position.name: Tilt position
tilt_position.description: Optional cover tilt position from 0 to 100.

percentage.name: Fan percentage
percentage.description: Optional fan speed percentage from 0 to 100.

hvac_mode.name: HVAC mode
hvac_mode.description: Optional climate HVAC mode such as heat, cool, auto, or off.

target_temp_low.name: Low temperature
target_temp_low.description: Optional lower climate setpoint for heat/cool ranges.

target_temp_high.name: High temperature
target_temp_high.description: Optional upper climate setpoint for heat/cool ranges.

preset_mode.name: Preset mode
preset_mode.description: Optional climate preset mode such as eco, away, comfort, or none.

fan_mode.name: Fan mode
fan_mode.description: Optional climate fan mode such as auto, low, medium, or high.

direction.name: Fan direction
direction.description: Optional fan direction such as forward or reverse.

humidity.name: Humidity
humidity.description: Optional humidifier or climate target humidity percentage.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: Optional humidifier mode such as normal, eco, away, boost, or sleep.

operation_mode.name: Operation mode
operation_mode.description: Optional water heater operation mode such as eco or performance.

away_mode.name: Away mode
away_mode.description: Optional water heater away mode flag.

fan_speed.name: Vacuum fan speed
fan_speed.description: Optional vacuum fan speed such as balanced, turbo, or max.

camera_action.name: Camera action
camera_action.description: Optional camera action such as snapshot, record, play_stream, enable_motion_detection, or disable_motion_detection.

filename.name: Filename
filename.description: Optional file path for camera.snapshot or camera.record.

media_player.name: Media player
media_player.description: Optional media player entity for camera.play_stream.

format.name: Stream format
format.description: Optional camera stream format for camera.play_stream.

command.name: Command
command.description: Optional platform-specific vacuum or remote command.

cleaning_area_id.name: Cleaning area IDs
cleaning_area_id.description: Optional Home Assistant area IDs for vacuum.clean_area.

activity.name: Remote activity
activity.description: Optional remote activity for remote.turn_on or remote.toggle.

device.name: Remote device
device.description: Optional remote device name for remote.send_command.

num_repeats.name: Remote repeat count
num_repeats.description: Optional number of times to repeat a remote command.

delay_secs.name: Remote delay
delay_secs.description: Optional delay in seconds between repeated remote commands.

hold_secs.name: Remote hold duration
hold_secs.description: Optional hold duration in seconds for remote commands that support it.

cycle.name: Cycle
cycle.description: Optional cycle flag for select/input_select next or previous actions.

code.name: Code
code.description: Optional alarm control panel code for arm/disarm services.

message.name: Message
message.description: Optional notification message for notify targets.

title.name: Title
title.description: Optional notification title for notify targets.

name.name: Name
name.description: Shopping list item name or service-specific display name.

data.name: Data
data.description: Optional notification data payload for notify targets.

service.name: Service
service.description: Optional service override for service-style action targets.

service_data.name: Service data
service_data.description: Additional service data for browser_mod, telegram_bot, tts, or other service-style action targets.

media_player_entity_id.name: Media player entity ID
media_player_entity_id.description: Media player entity for tts.speak or tts.cloud_say.

cache.name: Cache
cache.description: Whether TTS output should be cached where supported.

browser_id.name: Browser ID
browser_id.description: Browser Mod target browser ID or IDs.

user_id.name: User ID
user_id.description: Browser Mod target user ID or IDs.

action_text.name: Action text
action_text.description: Browser Mod notification action button text.

parse_mode.name: Parse mode
parse_mode.description: Telegram parse mode such as html, markdown, markdownv2, or plain_text.

disable_notification.name: Disable notification
disable_notification.description: Whether Telegram should send the message silently.

disable_web_page_preview.name: Disable web page preview
disable_web_page_preview.description: Whether Telegram should disable link previews.

message_tag.name: Message tag
message_tag.description: Optional Telegram message tag for later edits.

chat_id.name: Chat ID
chat_id.description: Optional Telegram chat ID or IDs.

todo_action.name: To-do action
todo_action.description: Optional todo action such as add_item, update_item, remove_item, clear_completed, or get_items.

item.name: To-do item
item.description: To-do item summary for add, update, complete, or remove actions.

status.name: To-do status
status.description: To-do status such as needs_action or completed.

due_date.name: To-do due date
due_date.description: Optional due date for todo.add_item or todo.update_item.

due_datetime.name: To-do due date and time
due_datetime.description: Optional due date and time for todo.add_item or todo.update_item.

description.name: To-do description
description.description: Optional description for todo.add_item or todo.update_item.

variables.name: Variables
variables.description: Optional script variables for script targets.

skip_condition.name: Skip condition
skip_condition.description: Whether automation.trigger should skip automation conditions.

datetime.name: Date and time
datetime.description: Optional input_datetime date and time value.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Optional duration for timer.start or siren.turn_on targets.

reverse.name: Reverse
reverse.description: Whether shopping_list.sort should sort in reverse order.

update_action.name: Update action
update_action.description: Action for update entities: install, skip, or clear_skipped.

backup.name: Backup
backup.description: Whether update.install should request a backup when supported.

location_name.name: Location name
location_name.description: Optional location name for device_tracker.see, such as home or not_home.

gps.name: GPS coordinates
gps.description: Optional latitude and longitude pair for device_tracker.see.

gps_accuracy.name: GPS accuracy
gps_accuracy.description: Optional GPS accuracy in meters for device_tracker.see.

update_entity.name: Update entity
update_entity.description: Whether to call homeassistant.update_entity for the target after applying the intent.

ttl.name: TTL (seconds)
ttl.description: How long the manual intent should be active. Default: 7200 (2 hours).

activate_scene.name: Activate scene
activate_scene.description: Manually activate a HA scene via a ha-intentional scene rule. Use this instead of scene.turn_on directly so the rule's transition and TTL are honored.

rule_id.name: Rule ID
rule_id.description: The id of a scene rule to activate. Must be a rule that references a HA scene.

ttl.name: TTL (seconds)
ttl.description: Override the rule's default TTL. 0 means use the rule's value.

clear.name: Clear manual intents
clear.description: Clear user-authority manual intents created by intentional.fire or state-drift overrides. If target is omitted, clears all manual intents.

target.name: Target
target.description: Optional target entity_id whose manual intents should be cleared.

reload.name: Reload rules
reload.description: Re-read rule files from disk without restarting the integration.
